customers_say: Customers find the door lock reliable and worth its price, with straightforward installation and easy operation. Moreover, they appreciate its comprehensive features and security capabilities, with one customer noting the anti-pry/tamper alarm. Additionally, they like its appearance and convenience, with one mentioning the camera's usefulness.

reviews.title: Excellent Smart Lock – Secure and Easy to Use
reviews.body: Very good smart lock with fast fingerprint recognition and multiple unlocking options. Easy to use, good build quality, and enhances home security. Installation was smooth and the app works well. Highly recommended. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

reviews.author: Aditya Tendulkar
reviews.title: A very good quality lock at a fraction of the cost of competitors.
reviews.body: Good Lock offers multiple features and a strong locking mechanism. While there was an issue with the camera, the customer support team was excellent and promptly sent me a replacement. The device includes a variety of unlocking options, such as fingerprint and face unlock, making it a worthwhile investment.

reviews.author: Sai
reviews.title: Great lock and great support from Lavna team
reviews.body: Really good smart lock! It works well and has a lot of features that can keep your house safe. The customer support is really responsive and they helped me go inside my house when the battery died, All in a simple video call! Special thanks to Jatin who handles the LA44 model support, He instructed me every step of way to reset locks, use emergency power ports, etc.
